title: The Knight in the Area
synopsis: Believing himself to be useless at football, Aizawa Kakeru opts to become the manager of his school's football team, while his brother Suguru is its ace, and is even good enough to represent Japan. However, Kakeru may be harbouring a strong talent within himself that only Suguru can see, and the two often get into arguments over Kakeru's denial of his skills. Things are made more complicated with the return of Nana, an old playmate of theirs that Kakeru has a crush on. Join the brothers in their journey to the national and even international championships! Story written under the penname Igano, Hiroaki.

title: Biingi Mabeopsonyeodo Yeonaehal Su Innayo
synonyms: Can Unpopular Magical Girls Also Date?
synopsis: Chae-Na, who plays the unpopular Clover in [Magical Lucky Stars], the group that protects Madeleine Village. She feels weak and inadequate as a hero, so she lives inconspicuously and endures being an unpopular member. She feels uncomfortable and awkward being in the spotlight. However, there is someone who falls in love with her at first sight after seeing her kindness! It is Red, a popular member of the [Transcendental Sentai Hyperranger] group that protects the neighboring Galaxy Village, Seung-Chan. "I fell in love at first sight. I think I like you!" She is excited by the appearance of Red, whom she admires, but refuses to confess, saying that she doesn't even know what kind of person she is... After hearing the heart-fluttering words that she doesn't know anything about you and wants to get to know you more, she eventually runs away. "There's no way such a cool person would like someone like me. There must be some kind of mistake!" A heart-fluttering story of a super popular hero and an unpopular magical girl who accepts his confession. (Source: Peanutoon, translated)

Riding the unprecedented occult boom, Inubosaki, an editor of a third-rate occult magazine, is covering strange incidents with his cameraman Asama, who is also psychic. Meanwhile, in the present day, 2023, an elderly Asama is visited by someone claiming to be Inubosaki's nephew. This is the start of a bizarre tale about forbidden memories that must not be unveiled.

title: Shin Souta no Houchou
synopsis: Sota Kitaoka, born in Shizunai, Hokkaido, to a family that ran a restaurant called "Kitaoka", moved to Tokyo for training in order to rebuild his family's run-down restaurant. There, he was discovered by the owner of "Tomikyu," a long-established ryotei restaurant in Ginza, where he underwent rigorous training, eventually becoming the head chef at Tomikyu. After that, he went on a culinary journey until he opened his own restaurant, "Tomikyu Kamui" in Nerima, Tokyo. A few years later, Sota is back at it again, this time to pursue the essence of "Omotenashi" (hospitality), just in time for the 2020 Tokyo Olympics! The long-awaited revival of the classic culinary manga! (Source: Bunkasha, translated)

One day, the new rookie Seike Shingo, is assigned as Kurokouchi's partner. Excellent, but naive and idealistic, he is the exact opposite of Kurokouchi, but nonetheless, the duo relentlessly chase down criminals.
